messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that rewrites GNU C++17 code into functionally equivalent variants. The code reads and writes I/O from the console.

samples.content:
<perturbed_code_1>
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <random>
#include <chrono>

using namespace std;

#define sz(v) (int)v.size()
#define ll long long
#define all(v)  v.begin() , v.end()
#define rall(v)  v.rbegin() , v.rend()
#define pf push_front
#define pb push_back
#define fast ios_base::sync_with_stdio(0); cin.tie(0); cout.tie(0);
#define Clear(container, value) memset(container, value, sizeof(container))
#define PI acos(-1.0)
#define forn(v, be, n) for(int v = be; v < n; v++)
#define se second
#define fr first

const ll Long_max = numeric_limits<ll>::max();
const int Int_max = numeric_limits<int>::max();

int dx[] = {1, -1, 0, 0, 1, -1, -1, 1};
int dy[] = {0, 0, -1, 1, 1, -1, 1, -1};

void file_input(string pathIn) {
    freopen(pathIn.c_str(), "r", stdin);
}

void file_output(string pathOut) {
    freopen(pathOut.c_str(), "w", stdout);
}

int msg() {
    random_device rd;
    mt19937 gen(rd());
    uniform_int_distribution<> dis(0, 4);
    vector<string> st = {
            "Wish everyone high ratings!",
            "Good luck!",
            "Have fun!",
            "Please, read all the problems!",
            "Go Go fight!" };
    cerr << st[dis(gen)];
    return 0;
}

int main() {
    fast;
    int n, v, sm;
    cin >> n;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        cin >> v;
        sm += v;
    }
    cout << sm / n;
    return 0;
}
